Vardiff Algorithm Benchmark — Wall Time

4 algorithms (classic, pid, qpid, champion) × 26 scenarios, run at real time (--speed 1) so handshake / TCP / idle-backstop / champion-tick latencies are represented faithfully. Setpoint = 4 shares/min. Regenerate with benchmark/benchmark.sh.

runs: 104failures/timeouts: 0setpoint: 4 spm

“never converged” = a step knocked the miner's target out of the ±20% band and it did not return before run end (≥180s observed) — the controller under-reacts to that direction. Up = miner sped up (pool must raise difficulty); down = miner slowed.

3. Per-miner breakout (worst offenders highlighted)

Each run's miners individually, sorted worst-first by settled accuracy (|expected−setpoint|/setpoint). The 5 worst per run are highlighted — a fleet whose pooled p50 looks fine can still have a stuck-off-target subset here. op spm = median settled operating point (setpoint 4); bw = that miner's steady-state on-wire rate (down+up). Fleets are collapsed; click a run to expand.
